entries.title: Midnight Ambiguous Zone
entries.description:
📍 From July to September 2026, DE Cinema presented Midnight Ambiguous Zone, a screening programme dedicated to Sinophone queer cinema in the Netherlands.

Coinciding with WorldPride Amsterdam 2026, we invited audiences to explore emotions and relationships that resist fixed labels. Through cinema, we sought to reimagine ambiguity, friendship, nights, encounters and farewells, as well as fluid forms of intimacy and ever-evolving senses of belonging.

Through these moving images from the Sinophone world, we hoped to collectively explore how queer experiences are seen, felt and discussed across different cultural and urban spaces.

🎬 Screening Schedule

📍 19 July (Sunday) | 15:30
Nowhere Bookstore | The Hague

Will You Look at Me | Dir. Huang Shuli (Queer Palm Award for Best Short Film)
Heart Murmurs | Dir. Zhang Ziyin
China PK Queen | Dir. Wei Jiangang
Quietly Tell Her | Dir. Chen Pinru

📍 24 July (Friday) | The Pulse | Amsterdam

18:30 | The Last Year of Darkness
92 min | Documentary | 2023
20:10 | Live Online Q&A with director Benjamin Mullinkosson

📍 25 July (Saturday) | The Pulse | Amsterdam

18:30 | Blue Gate Crossing
83 min | Fiction | 2002

📍 4 August (Tuesday) | KINO | Rotterdam

19:15 | Blue Gate Crossing

📍 8 September (Tuesday) | KINO | Rotterdam

19:15 | The Last Year of Darkness

entries.title: After the Last Light
entries.description:
Together with @worm.rotterdam, we are pleased to present After the Last Light, the first programme in the "Nocturnal Wonderlands" Short Film Screening Series.

The programme features a selection of short films that explore passing encounters, quiet emotion traces, and subtle moments of strangeness that surface in daily personal life after every nightfall.

Across seven short films, this programme examines the shifting relationship among vision, light, and the existence of the image.

Moving between personal memory, sensory perception, and technological environments, these films examine how images emerge at the limits of visibility.

Some turn toward blindness and the ways images can be constructed through touch, sound, and imagination. Others examine landscapes transformed by artificial illumination, where light no longer reveals the world but overwhelms it.

🎬Film Line-up
In Another Night (2024) — Yunyi Zhu
Chroma (2024) — Yunyi Zhu
Everything Near Becomes Distant (2022) — Yunyi Zhu
Look on the Bright Side (2023) - Yuyan Wang
The Moon Also Rises (2024) — Yuyan Wang
Of Dreams in the Dream of Another Mirror (2023) - Yunyi Zhu
The World Remains Our First and Last Love (2025) - Yunyi Zhu

📅Time: 1 April, 20:30
📍Location: @worm.rotterdam
Boomgaardsstraat 71, 3012 BN Rotterdam
